development_network.title: FFE development network
development_network.architecture: Technically a graph; the UI may display a tree, rings or a neural network.
core_rules: Fundamental rights are independent of rank, skill, fame, money, Mojo or office.
A higher ring means a wider scope of responsibility, not a higher human worth.
Unlocking means a recommendation or demonstrated skill; only law/safety/contracts can create genuinely mandatory gates.
People may use several archetypes at the same time.
The tree is not a happiness score or a global life ranking.
Each node will later need evidence, failure modes, when-not-to-use guidance and review.
Suitable levels are earned in regular assessment/evidence windows; successful advancement can then be celebrated voluntarily in cohorts.

celebration_framework.principle: Celebrations are not automatically triggered by a node. Suitable levels have regular voluntary assessment/evidence windows. Anyone who passes a level through the appropriate process can be honoured with their cohort in a separate transition celebration.
flow: Register for the next assessment or evidence window
an appropriate form of evidence for each skill
fair assessment against criteria known in advance
on passing: update level / authority / Angeberschein
a shared advancement celebration for all successful participants
then make new opportunities and responsibilities visible

assessment_modes.best_for: specific craft, technical or operational skills
assessment_modes.example: a workpiece, safe execution, fault diagnosis
a completed project plus an explanation of the decisions

assessment_modes.best_for: social, facilitation, care or leadership skills
assessment_modes.example: several real situations rather than an artificial one-off assessment

assessment_modes.best_for: knowledge, understanding and the ability to explain
assessment_modes.example: explain the matter, answer follow-up questions, name limits

assessment_modes.best_for: legally, normatively or professionally standardised qualifications
assessment_modes.example: a welding qualification, driving licence, formal certification

assessment_modes.best_for: skills where several perspectives are useful
assessment_modes.example: standardised criteria, several assessors rather than a popularity vote

assessment_rules: Not every skill needs an assessment.
The form of evidence follows the type of skill, not a uniform ritual.
Criteria must be known before the assessment.
Assessors must be suitably qualified and free from relevant conflicts of interest.
Failures are not publicly celebrated or used to shame people.
Retakes and learning paths must be possible.
For safety-critical skills, reassessments or expiry dates may be appropriate.
A passed rank demonstrates a specific skill or readiness for responsibility, not a higher human worth.
celebration_eligible_events: a mentor or assessor level reached
an organisational level achieved together by a dynasty

celebration_format.description: Everyone who passed a level in the relevant period can be honoured together at an assembly / celebration — similar to a transition or coming-of-age ritual, but culturally designed freely by FFE or the local community concerned.
building_blocks: make a qualifying piece, learning path or short story visible
symbolically present a badge, artefact or Angeberschein
publicly reveal the new level only with consent
music, food, dance, games or local rituals

hard_limits: no humiliation, painful initiation or dare
no loss of fundamental rights for non-participation
no popularity vote as a substitute for competence assessment
celebration_framework.privacy: Assessment results and visibility at the celebration are handled separately. A person can receive a level without having to be celebrated publicly.

operational_profiles.title: Grundrechte-Charta
operational_profiles.activate_when: a rule, sanction, allocation or decision could affect fundamental rights, membership rights or essential access
operational_profiles.goal: identify affected rights early and prevent majorities, status, capital or technology from bypassing the protected core
must_check: Which fundamental right or membership right is affected?
What legal/normative basis supports the interference?
Is there a less restrictive, equally effective approach?
What routes exist for complaint, protection and review?
hard_bounds: Fundamental rights also apply to unpopular people and minorities.
Mojo, capital, expertise or popularity must not buy fundamental rights.
Urgent measures must remain narrow, time-limited and reviewable.
operational_profiles.culture: No cultural practice may qualify the core of fundamental rights.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: F02 Non-participation · F03 Exit · F04 Privacy · F05 Minority protection · F08 Proportionality · D06 Fundamental rights council
failure_modes: **Rights inflation:** Everything becomes a fundamental right.
**Rule by judges:** Oversight bodies write policy.
**Popularity-based rights:** Unpopular people receive less protection in practice.
**Paper rights:** Rights exist, but nobody knows about or can access them.
operational_profiles.escalation: Where there is a credible serious fundamental rights violation, external law or an urgent need for protection, escalate immediately to the responsible council/specialist body.
operational_profiles.output: Fundamental rights review with facts, affected rights, permitted options, protective measures and review.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core of fundamental rights adopted · 🟡 later additions possible · ⚖️ legal embedding later

operational_profiles.title: Right not to participate
operational_profiles.activate_when: participation, an event, ritual, community work, visibility or loyalty is described as voluntary
operational_profiles.goal: ensure genuine voluntariness and make the real costs of saying no visible
must_check: Is the activity mandatory, voluntary or private?
What does a person lose in practice by saying no?
Does saying no affect commissions, status, Mojo, access or belonging?
Is there a neutral path for non-participation?
Must saying no be justified publicly?
hard_bounds: No disadvantage for declining voluntary cultural activities.
No hidden obligation through status, friendship or economic power.
Contracts and safety duties remain honestly identified as obligations.
operational_profiles.culture: A voluntary ritual may be beautiful and connecting, but must never become a test of belonging.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: F01 Fundamental rights · B06 Freedom of ritual · B07 Multiple affiliations · W05 Working modes · B01 Admission
operational_profiles.escalation: If saying no leads to economic, social or legal disadvantages, also review F05/D09/D06.
operational_profiles.output: Participation card: mode, costs of saying no, alternative, responsible people and review.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · 🧪 costs-of-saying-no pilot · ⚖️ legal gate

operational_profiles.title: Exit & portability
operational_profiles.activate_when: a person wants to leave a project, office, dynasty, membership or data/customer relationship
operational_profiles.goal: enable a dignified, legally sound exit with portability and a clear handover
must_check: Which contracts and obligations are ongoing?
Which data, skills, evidence and personal content are portable?
Which commons, customer or brand rights are affected?
What transitional or alumni relationship is desired?
hard_bounds: Leaving is not betrayal.
No data hostage, skill hostage or eternal tithe.
Third-party rights, ongoing contracts and duties of protection remain in force.
operational_profiles.culture: A dignified farewell or handover ritual is possible, but voluntary.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: B01 Admission · W10 Customer pool · K05 Angeberschein · T05 Access power · R03 Friendly separation
operational_profiles.escalation: For disputes over assets, contracts, customer data or membership, involve external legal/specialist advice.
operational_profiles.output: Exit dossier with obligations, exports, handovers, access termination and completion date.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · 🟡 formal eG exit parameters in the articles of association · ⚖️ legal gate

operational_profiles.title: Privacy & data autonomy
operational_profiles.activate_when: data is to be collected, combined, analysed, shared or used for matching/AI
operational_profiles.goal: ensure data sovereignty, purpose limitation and minimal informational power
must_check: What specific purpose justifies each field?
Who can access it and why?
How do information access, export, withdrawal of consent and deletion work?
hard_bounds: No secret social or trust scores.
Data minimisation before technical convenience.
Do not feed conflict, health or relationship data into marketplace rankings.
recommended_path: Zweck und Rechtsgrundlage je Feld festlegen
operational_profiles.culture: No cultural obligation to disclose personal areas of life.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: K10 Rubin AI · T05 Access power · T06 Cybersecurity · B04 Rehabilitation · D07 Power map
operational_profiles.escalation: For highly sensitive data, extensive profiling or external sharing, trigger specialist data protection review/DPIA.
operational_profiles.output: Data protection factsheet with purpose, fields, access, retention period, data subject rights and fallback.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · 🧪 data inventory/privacy pilot · ⚖️ GDPR/legal gate

operational_profiles.title: Equal treatment & minority protection
operational_profiles.activate_when: admission, opportunities, resources, sanctions, visibility or procedures are distributed differently
operational_profiles.goal: ensure fair criteria, minority protection and protection for socially vulnerable or unpopular people too
must_check: What criteria apply, and were they published in advance?
Is there indirect disadvantage or a clique effect?
Are barrier removal or reasonable accommodations needed?
hard_bounds: No disadvantage based on protected or irrelevant characteristics.
Unpopularity is not grounds for exclusion.
A majority replaces neither fundamental rights nor fair process.
operational_profiles.culture: Local culture may be diverse, but must not create a second membership system.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: F01 Fundamental rights · D06 Fundamental rights council · D09 Conflicts of interest · B01 Admission · W01 Marketplace
failure_modes: a protected category becomes a ranking of people
operational_profiles.escalation: For structural discrimination, conflicts involving fundamental rights or external AGG/legal issues, escalate to a specialist body/council.
operational_profiles.output: Fairness review with criteria, effects, protective measures and a complaints route.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · 🧪 process pilot · ⚖️ legal gate

operational_profiles.title: Mission
operational_profiles.activate_when: a new business area, project, growth step, capital offer or major system is proposed
operational_profiles.goal: check whether the activity actually strengthens FFE freedom, shared infrastructure and societal benefit
must_check: Who bears costs and external effects?
What dependence or concentration of power is created?
Which alternative fulfils the mission better?
How will we recognise mission drift?
hard_bounds: The mission does not justify fundamental rights violations.
The business model can be changed; the purpose cannot be changed secretly.
Growth is not an end in itself.
operational_profiles.culture: Stories and symbols may carry the mission, but must not replace criticism.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: F07 Negative mission · W02 Tithe · W04 Infrastructure · R04 Growth · R05 Mission balance sheet
failure_modes: **Mission drift:** Gradual shifts driven by money/incentives.
**Mission purity:** Every pragmatic concession is seen as betrayal.
**Founder mission:** A historical founder preference becomes permanent.
operational_profiles.escalation: Where goals conflict with fundamental rights, external law or funding essential to survival, involve the whole community/specialist review.
operational_profiles.output: Mission-fit brief with benefits, risks, alternatives, metrics and review.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ mission adopted · 🟡 later editorial refinement possible

operational_profiles.title: Negative mission / anti-cult limits
operational_profiles.activate_when: exclusive loyalty, founder worship, information isolation or ever greater personal sacrifices are expected
operational_profiles.goal: identify totalising or cult-like dynamics early and limit them institutionally
must_check: Do external contacts and multiple affiliations remain protected?
Do the rules also apply to leaders?
Who can complain or review independently?
hard_bounds: No loyalty oaths to individuals.
No control of private relationships/information.
Criticism and external contacts remain legitimate.
operational_profiles.culture: Strong culture is allowed; admiration must remain voluntary and never become an obligation to obey.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: F02 Non-participation · F03 Exit · F04 Privacy · B06 Freedom of ritual · B07 Multiple affiliations · R07 Founder dependence
failure_modes: anti-cult rhetoric itself becomes a claim to moral superiority
every strong emotion is treated as suspicious
criticism of the founder is permitted only symbolically
“voluntary” with high costs for saying no
operational_profiles.escalation: For abuse of power, intimidation, isolation or severe dependence, involve an independent/external protection body.
operational_profiles.output: Anti-totalising report with warning signs, countermeasures, responsibility and review.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ protective core adopted · 🔬 ongoing experience/research review

operational_profiles.title: Proportionality
operational_profiles.activate_when: an obligation, restriction, sanction, safety measure or emergency rule is introduced
operational_profiles.goal: allow only suitable, necessary and minimally restrictive interventions
must_check: What legitimate objective or specific harm?
Is there a less restrictive, equally effective means?
How can it be revoked or challenged?
hard_bounds: Convenience is not an emergency.
The core of fundamental rights and mandatory law retain priority.
Scope, duration and oversight must be proportional.
operational_profiles.culture: Symbolic sanctions must not be harsher than objectively necessary.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: F01 Fundamental rights · D06 Fundamental rights council · B02 Repair ladder · T01 Safety stop
failure_modes: a less restrictive alternative was not seriously considered
operational_profiles.escalation: For substantial interference with fundamental rights, external legal issues or immediate danger, involve the responsible specialist/fundamental rights council.
operational_profiles.output: Proportionality note with objective, alternatives, scope, deadline and review.

operational_profiles.title: Access to law and rules
operational_profiles.activate_when: a binding rule is to be created, changed, interpreted or applied
operational_profiles.goal: ensure that rules are findable, understandable, versioned and clear about jurisdiction
must_check: To whom does it apply, and from when?
Where are the short and full versions?
How can it be challenged or changed?
hard_bounds: No secret binding rules.
AI must not be the only route to access the law.
Old versions are archived, not presented as current.
operational_profiles.culture: Cultural rules are marked as culture and are not secretly made legally enforceable.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: D08 Norm architecture · K10 Rubin AI · R06 Bureaucracy radar · T10 Fallback · K02 Decision brief
failure_modes: a rule exists only in a chat
an AI answer becomes a new norm
operational_profiles.escalation: For conflicting norms, D08; for legal uncertainty, specialist review; for unclear communication, a reader/user test.
operational_profiles.output: Publishable rule card with rank, scope, version, summary, full text and remedy.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · 🧪 reader/user tests · ⚖️ legal gate

operational_profiles.title: Affectedness & subsidiarity
operational_profiles.activate_when: it is unclear which person, project, dynasty or higher level should decide
operational_profiles.goal: place decisions as locally as possible, with full capacity to take responsibility and protection for affected outsiders
must_check: Which level has the knowledge and resources?
Are there spillovers onto other groups?
Are fundamental rights or shared interfaces affected?
Can the local level bear and correct the consequences?
hard_bounds: As local as sensible, as shared as necessary.
Local autonomy must not ignore fundamental rights or external effects.
A higher level receives only justified, enumerated responsibilities.
operational_profiles.culture: Local communities may freely design their form; interfaces remain compatible.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: D06 Jurisdiction council · R01 Dynasties · R02 Federation · F01 Fundamental rights
failure_modes: **Affectedness inflation:** Everyone claims to be affected by everything.
**Centralisation reflex:** Every interface is moved upwards.
operational_profiles.escalation: For disputes over competence, D06 Jurisdiction council; for several communities, R02 level.
operational_profiles.output: Jurisdiction memo with affected people, decision level, limits, interfaces and review.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · 🧪 jurisdiction cases · ⚖️ legal gate

operational_profiles.title: Voting architecture
operational_profiles.activate_when: a binding vote, election, prioritisation or budget decision is being prepared
operational_profiles.goal: choose a clear procedure suited to the type of decision before the outcome is known
must_check: How significant and reversible is the decision?
What legal requirement or provision in the articles of association applies?
What level of complexity does the group understand?
hard_bounds: Set the procedure before the outcome.
One basic political vote per member.
A majority must not override fundamental rights.
Credits, capital or Mojo do not buy a core vote.
operational_profiles.culture: Schützenfest can be a limited governance pilot; the legally effective vote remains separate.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: D04 Deliberation · D05 Sortition councils · D10 Constitutional amendment · K02 Decision brief · W07 Capital & investors
failure_modes: election rules set only after polling
operational_profiles.escalation: For votes under the articles of association, elections to governing bodies, legal requirements or matters close to fundamental rights, involve legal review or D10.
operational_profiles.output: Voting plan with Method-ID, justification, voting rules, counting, protection and minutes.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · ✅ method library v1.0 · 🧪 method pilots · ⚖️ articles/election-law gate

operational_profiles.title: Caesar – founder's dignity, right to be heard & representation
operational_profiles.activate_when: Rubin as Caesar wishes to be heard in a decision or to represent FFE culturally/diplomatically
operational_profiles.goal: make room for the founder's knowledge and symbolism without transferring democratic decision-making power
must_check: Has Caesar explicitly invoked the right to be heard?
When can a fair hearing take place without delay?
Should Caesar speak before or after independent opinions are formed?
Is this only cultural representation, or legal representation?
hard_bounds: No veto, no additional vote, no power to issue instructions.
No entitlement to unlimited speaking time or delay.
Without a mandate, cultural representation is not legal representation.
recommended_path: wo sinnvoll unabhängige Positionen vorab sichern
operational_profiles.culture: Honours, history and diplomatic travel are culturally possible; legendary status remains voluntary.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: D04 Deliberation · D07 Power map · F07 Anti-totalising limits · R07 Founder dependence · K10 Rubin AI
failure_modes: **Founder worship:** Criticism of Rubin becomes culturally taboo.
**Soft veto:** Nobody disagrees, although no formal veto exists.
**Endless hearing:** Speaking rights become a delaying tactic.
**Court entourage:** Closeness to Caesar becomes a resource for access or status.
operational_profiles.escalation: For embedding in the articles of association, powers of representation or a serious power conflict, involve legal review/the mirror council.
operational_profiles.output: Hearing record: request, time, contribution, limits, decision and representation mandate.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · ⚖️ legal gate if embedded in the articles of association

operational_profiles.title: Deliberation before decision
operational_profiles.activate_when: a complex, contentious or highly consequential decision needs discussion before the vote
operational_profiles.goal: enable shared understanding, genuine counterarguments and informed personal positions
must_check: Which facts are agreed, and which disputed?
Which alternatives and objections have not yet been heard?
When has there been enough discussion?
hard_bounds: Deliberation replaces neither fundamental rights nor a decision by the competent body.
No forced consensus.
Silence does not automatically count as consent.
operational_profiles.culture: Humour and rituals may ease tension, but must not ridicule anyone.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: K02 Decision brief · K03 Fact–forecast–value · D05 Sortition councils · D02 Voting architecture · D03 Caesar · K07 Decision journal
operational_profiles.escalation: For safety, fundamental rights or unequal power, escalate to D06/D07/F01.
operational_profiles.output: Deliberation report with facts, values, options, objections, changes and remaining dissent.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · 🧪 format pilot · 🔬 research

operational_profiles.title: Sortition councils / mini-publics
operational_profiles.activate_when: an independent advisory/review group is needed and elections/availability always favour the same people
operational_profiles.goal: broaden temporary participation through a suitable volunteer pool and random selection
must_check: Who belongs in the selection pool?
What training and information does the council need?
How can the mandate remain short and reviewable?
hard_bounds: Participation is voluntary and supported.
Random selection does not replace required professional qualifications.
No hidden agenda or manipulated pool formation.
operational_profiles.culture: The pilot may develop its own playful culture; selection and decision rules remain transparent.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: D04 Deliberation · D02 Voting · D06 Rights/jurisdiction · K02 Decision brief · R09 Organisation check
operational_profiles.escalation: For a statutory body, professional duty or conflict over representation, involve D02/legal review.
operational_profiles.output: Sortition council dossier with pool, draw, mandate, briefing, outcome and evaluation.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ methodological direction adopted · 🧪 Schützenfest/sortition council pilot · ⚖️ legal gate

operational_profiles.title: Conflict, fundamental rights & jurisdiction council
operational_profiles.activate_when: a conflict, alleged fundamental rights violation or jurisdiction dispute cannot be resolved informally
operational_profiles.goal: choose the right mode and resolve it fairly, proportionately and with minimal data
must_check: Is this a relationship conflict, fundamental rights issue or jurisdiction matter?
Is there immediate danger or an imbalance of power?
Who has a conflict of interest?
hard_bounds: With people, not about people.
No forced mediation or reconciliation.
No judgment based on rumour alone.
Private matters stay within the smallest possible circle.
operational_profiles.culture: Local communities may culturally design their council, location, symbols and voluntary rituals; the procedural core remains firm.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: F01 Fundamental rights · F08 Proportionality · D01 Subsidiarity · B02 Repair ladder · B03 Restorative justice · B04 Rehabilitation · D09 Conflicts of interest
failure_modes: **Tribunal inflation:** Every conflict becomes a formal case.
**Rule by Judges:** the council replaces political decision-making.
**Clique Capture:** the same people control complaints.
**Forum shopping:** Participants seek the most favourable mode.
operational_profiles.escalation: For violence, criminal offences, external legal questions, urgent safety concerns or serious fundamental rights issues, involve a specialist/protection body immediately.
operational_profiles.output: Reasoned conflict/fundamental rights/jurisdiction decision with protection, conditions, remedies and review.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · 🧪 case pilot · ⚖️ legal gate

operational_profiles.title: Power map & mirror council
operational_profiles.activate_when: a role, platform, resource, person or institution could gain disproportionate influence
operational_profiles.goal: make formal and informal power visible and build appropriate controls
must_check: Which decisions, resources, data, access and agenda does the source of power control?
What countervailing power or transparency exists?
How can abuse be identified and corrected?
hard_bounds: No comprehensive friendship graph by default.
Power analysis must not itself become surveillance.
Mojo/status is a source of power, but not a judgment of a person's worth.
operational_profiles.culture: The Hofnarr and Loyaler Stachel can provide cultural counter-power, but do not replace formal controls.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: D03 Caesar · D09 Conflict of interest · T07 Network resilience · W07 Investors · R07 Founder dependence · R09 Organisation check
failure_modes: **Power hunting:** Every form of expertise is treated as suspicious.
**Blind spot:** Informal friendship/patronage power goes unrecorded.
**Mirror council oligarchy:** Those overseeing others become unchecked themselves.
operational_profiles.escalation: For powers over sanctions, personnel, money, root access or fundamental rights, trigger strong oversight/external review.
operational_profiles.output: Power-control matrix with sources, risks, counter-power, transparency and review.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · 🧪 power map/mirror council pilot

operational_profiles.title: Norm architecture
operational_profiles.activate_when: a new norm, framework, method or cultural practice is created or changed
operational_profiles.goal: clearly establish normative rank, jurisdiction, amendability and conflict rules
must_check: Is it a fundamental right, constitutional principle, articles of association, regulation, method, soft law, culture or experiment?
How is it published and reviewed?
hard_bounds: A lower norm must not override a higher norm.
Culture does not secretly become mandatory.
An experiment is not presented as law in force.
operational_profiles.culture: Cultural names and rituals are permitted if their legal status remains honestly identified.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: F01 Fundamental rights · D10 Constitutional amendment · K01 Evidence system · R08 Lifecycle
failure_modes: **Soft-law coercion:** An allegedly voluntary guideline is mandatory in practice.
**Rule evasion:** Power is deliberately hidden in “methods” to avoid oversight.
**Overloaded articles:** Every detail becomes a matter for notarisation.
operational_profiles.escalation: For articles of association, external law or conflicting norms, trigger legal/specialist review.
operational_profiles.output: Norm factsheet with rank, adoption authority, applicability, conflict rule, amendment and review.

operational_profiles.title: Conflict of interest & recusal
operational_profiles.activate_when: a decision-maker has their own financial, personal, family, political or organisational interests
operational_profiles.goal: make conflicts of interest visible and protect trust through appropriate mitigation
must_check: Could it influence the outcome or perceptions?
Is disclosure enough, or is abstention/recusal needed?
How is this documented without unnecessary disclosure of private matters?
hard_bounds: No secret relevant interests.
Disclosure is not punished.
A conflicted person does not decide on their own conflict of interest alone.
operational_profiles.culture: Cultural closeness or friendship is not banned wholesale; specific decision-making power is assessed.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: D07 Power map · W01 Marketplace · W07 Investors · D06 Council · R09 Organisation check
operational_profiles.escalation: For governing-body, procurement, personnel, fund or sanction decisions with a significant conflict, use external/higher-level review.
operational_profiles.output: Conflict note with interest, assessment, measure, substitute and record.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · 🧪 process pilot · ⚖️ legal gate

operational_profiles.title: Constitutional amendment & high thresholds
operational_profiles.activate_when: fundamental rights, the mission, articles of association or foundational power/organisational rules are to be changed
operational_profiles.goal: change fundamental rules more slowly, with better information and greater stability than everyday practice
must_check: Why is a regulation/experiment not enough?
What transition and legitimate-expectation issues arise?
Which legally required majority or registration applies?
When will the change be reviewed?
hard_bounds: No permanent constitutional amendment in a convenience-driven emergency.
Fundamental rights require the highest threshold.
Protection against retroactive effects and protection of existing claims are maintained.
operational_profiles.culture: A Constitution Day can prepare changes, but cannot replace the required legal form.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: F01 Fundamental rights · F06 Mission · D08 Norm architecture · D02 Voting · K07 Decision journal
operational_profiles.escalation: For amendments under GenG/to the articles of association, the audit association/notary/register procedure must be followed.
operational_profiles.output: Constitutional amendment file with old/new norm, reasons, procedure, vote, transition and review.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · 🟡 majorities/deadlines with the charter and articles of association · ⚖️ legal gate

operational_profiles.title: Opportunities marketplace & matching
operational_profiles.activate_when: an opportunity, task, position, learning opportunity, help, resource or cooperation is offered/matched
operational_profiles.goal: create fair, voluntary matches between needs, competence, working mode and protection requirements
must_check: Which working or usage arrangement applies?
hard_bounds: The community does not allocate people.
No secret ranking of people.
Voluntary help must not conceal paid work.
The reality of the contractual relationship determines status.
operational_profiles.culture: Local language and a playful feel are possible; access criteria remain understandable.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: W05 Working modes · W08 Quality · W10 Customer pool · K05 Angeberschein · D09 Conflicts of interest · T09 Operations
failure_modes: **Friend algorithm:** Old contacts are repeatedly favoured.
**Reputation poverty trap:** No commission without evidence, no evidence without a commission.
**Hidden ranking:** Nobody knows why others see commissions.
operational_profiles.escalation: For uncertainty about employment/self-employment, safety, discrimination or sensitive data, seek specialist review.
operational_profiles.output: Offer/match card with mode, payment, criteria, responsible people, contract and review.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · 🧪 marketplace pilot · ⚖️ contract/status gate · 🔬 matching research

operational_profiles.title: Tithe / community contribution
operational_profiles.activate_when: external monetary value arises from an activity substantially enabled, organised or supported by FFE
operational_profiles.goal: correctly calculate a single transparent 10% community share and direct all of it to GEG
must_check: Is the value transaction externally monetised and substantially enabled by FFE?
What is the actual net payment received?
Which genuine external direct or pass-through costs are deducted?
Has a tithe already been applied to the transaction?
hard_bounds: One value transaction — one tithe.
No wage deduction.
No automatic share for dynasties/integrators/offices.
No toll on friendship or free lending.
operational_profiles.culture: Voluntary alms are possible for non-monetised lending, but not a hidden fee.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: W01 Opportunities marketplace · W03 Commons pass · W04 Infrastructure · W05 Working modes · W06 GEG · W10 Customer pool · D09 Conflicts of interest
operational_profiles.escalation: For uncertainty about tax, contracts, labour leasing or sector rules, seek specialist advice.
operational_profiles.output: Tithe statement with payment, tax, direct costs, basis, 10%, 90%, booking and correction.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ tithe regulations v0.1 adopted · 🧪 calculation/operations pilot · ⚖️ tax/contract gate

operational_profiles.title: Commons-Pass
operational_profiles.activate_when: an object, space, dataset, fund, tool, knowledge or other resource is shared
operational_profiles.goal: establish clear boundaries, maintenance, costs, access, decisions and exit for a commons
must_check: What is the resource, and who legally owns it?
Who may use it, and according to which criteria?
What happens in cases of scarcity, damage or misuse?
How does the commons end or split?
hard_bounds: Shared does not mean ownerless.
No private capture of shared resources.
Monitoring without unnecessary surveillance.
operational_profiles.culture: Commons may have local rituals/a maintenance culture; rights and costs remain clear.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: W02 Tithe · W04 Infrastructure · D01 Subsidiarity · F03 Exit · D07 Power map · R08 Lifecycle
failure_modes: **Tragedy by vagueness:** Nobody knows who is responsible.
**Insider commons:** Formally shared, but in practice only friends have access.
**Maintenance debt:** Everyone uses it, nobody maintains it.
**Monitoring creep:** Resource protection becomes surveillance of people.
operational_profiles.escalation: For ownership, liability, data protection, hazardous substances or a large fund, seek specialist review.
operational_profiles.output: Completed commons pass with resource, users, maintenance, costs, governance, conflict and ending.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · 🧪 commons pass pilot · ⚖️ ownership/contract gate

operational_profiles.title: Shared infrastructure
operational_profiles.activate_when: a shared platform or space, tool, administration, AI or procurement infrastructure is being built
operational_profiles.goal: reduce fixed costs, make independence easier and avoid lock-in
must_check: Who uses and finances the infrastructure?
What problem does it measurably solve?
How portable are content and relationships?
When is building in-house worthwhile instead of using an external service?
hard_bounds: No data or customer hostages.
Infrastructure must not own the relationship.
No investment without governance and a decommissioning path.
operational_profiles.culture: Shared places and workshops may have a strong character; access remains fair.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: W02 Tithe · W03 Commons pass · K10 Rubin AI · F03 Portability · T10 Fallback
operational_profiles.escalation: For high investment, sensitive data, monopoly dependence or legal risk, involve a higher level/specialist review.
operational_profiles.output: Infrastructure decision brief with needs, costs, governance, data protection, exit and pilot.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · 🧪 business-case pilot · ⚖️ legal gate

operational_profiles.title: Working modes & fair remuneration
operational_profiles.activate_when: a person works, helps, learns, provides care or regularly takes responsibility
operational_profiles.goal: honestly distinguish work, learning, care and voluntary modes and provide fair remuneration
must_check: Is it voluntary, learning, care or paid work?
Who gives instructions and bears risk?
Is Mojo replacing money or an assessment of employment status?
hard_bounds: Meaning does not replace wages.
Membership creates no obligation to work.
Mojo replaces neither pay nor employment law.
No fake-learning or pseudo-freelance arrangements.
operational_profiles.culture: Spontaneous neighbourly help may stay simple; recurring essential work is addressed structurally.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: W01 Marketplace · W02 Tithe · B05 Care · K05 Academy · F02 Non-participation · W09 Management
failure_modes: **Volunteer creep:** A voluntary exception becomes a permanent task.
**Fake learning:** Beginners do cheap productive work under a training label.
operational_profiles.escalation: For employment-status, tax, social insurance, training or labour-leasing risks, seek specialist advice.
operational_profiles.output: Working-relationship card with affiliation, mode, mandate, task, payment, status and exit.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · ✅ Mojo pilot regulations v0.1 · 🧪 six-month review · ⚖️ employment/tax gate

operational_profiles.title: GEG – shared pot, budget & solidarity
operational_profiles.activate_when: tithes, donations, alms, fund, solidarity or community resources are planned, distributed or requested
operational_profiles.goal: manage GEG transparently in purpose-specific pots and enable help without patronage or debts of loyalty
must_check: What is the source of the money?
Which GEG pot and purpose restriction?
Who decides up to what limit?
Is there a conflict of interest?
Is it a grant, loan, in-kind support or project budget?
Does this create an insurance promise?
hard_bounds: The whole tithe belongs to the community.
No institutional sinecures.
Emergency aid is not based on Mojo.
Help does not buy obedience.
operational_profiles.culture: Alms, thanks and solidarity rituals are possible; applicants do not owe public gratitude.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: W02 Tithe · B05 Care & Mutual Aid · W03 Commons Pass · W07 Capital · F05 Equal Treatment · D09 Conflict of Interest
operational_profiles.escalation: For risk-related benefits resembling entitlements, seek insurance/legal review; for major spending, involve the whole community.
operational_profiles.output: GEG decision with source, pot, purpose, amount, mode, data protection, decision and report.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ GEG basic architecture adopted · 🟡 annual budget/sub-fund parameters · 🧪 initial pilot · ⚖️ insurance gate

operational_profiles.title: Cooperative capital & investors
operational_profiles.activate_when: membership shares, loans, grants, investors or other sources of capital are to be taken on
operational_profiles.goal: raise capital without selling basic political equality and the mission
must_check: Which instrument, and for what purpose?
What consequences for exit or crisis?
Does it fit the articles of association and the member-benefit purpose?
hard_bounds: Capital buys no basic political dignity, Mojo or additional vote.
Promoting members' interests remains central.
Individual funders must not control FFE in practice.
operational_profiles.culture: Honorary titles or thanks for funding must not grant hidden political power.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: W02 Community contribution · D02 Voting architecture · D07 Power map · D09 Conflict of interest · R05 Mission balance sheet
operational_profiles.escalation: For investing members, investment products, loans or larger instruments, involve the audit association/legal/tax advice.
operational_profiles.output: Capital dossier with needs, instrument, rights, limits, return, concentration, exit and resolution.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ political core adopted · 🟡 amounts/instruments in the economic plan · ⚖️ articles/capital gate

operational_profiles.title: Brand, quality & liability
operational_profiles.activate_when: a service or product under a shared brand is offered, approved or subject to a complaint
operational_profiles.goal: consistently connect the brand promise, competence, quality, acceptance, liability and repair
must_check: What exactly does the brand promise?
What freedom over the process remains with those doing the work?
hard_bounds: Brand access is not based on loyalty or opinions.
A certificate does not replace ability.
Safety and external authorisation take priority.
operational_profiles.culture: Mastery and advancement rituals may celebrate ability; approval remains objective.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: W01 Marketplace · K05 Angeberschein · T03 Checklists/handoffs · T08 Postmortem · W04 Infrastructure
operational_profiles.escalation: For regulated trades, product safety, personal injury or recalls, involve a specialist body/insurer.
operational_profiles.output: Quality and liability plan with promise, skill gate, assessment, acceptance, liability and repair.

operational_profiles.title: Integrator & management
operational_profiles.activate_when: several independent contributions, teams, dynasties or trades must be integrated into one outcome
operational_profiles.goal: Coordinate interfaces professionally without creating hidden authority over staff
must_check: Which decisions may the integrator make?
Where does coordination end and the power to give instructions/the employer role begin?
hard_bounds: An integrator does not own people, customers or dynasties.
Mandate and payment visible in advance.
No concealed employment or labour leasing.
operational_profiles.culture: Project culture may be playful; responsibility and contracts remain clear.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: W01 Marketplace · W05 Working modes · D07 Power map · D01 Subsidiarity · R07 Succession
operational_profiles.escalation: For instructions to personnel, liability, safety or employment-status risk, escalate to project management/legal review.
operational_profiles.output: Integration plan with mandate, roles, interfaces, payment, decisions, handoffs and review.

operational_profiles.title: Customer pool & customer relationships as a shared economic commons
operational_profiles.activate_when: leads, CRM data, brand relationships, follow-up commissions or customer contacts are built/distributed together
operational_profiles.goal: manage customer relationships as an economic commons without owning people or contacts
must_check: Where does the lead come from?
What applies on exit, follow-up work or the tithe?
hard_bounds: A customer is not property.
No perpetual tithe or contact ban without an actual FFE service.
Data protection and the customer's wishes remain paramount.
operational_profiles.culture: Relationships may grow into genuine personal connections; the community does not charge a toll on friendship.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: W01 Marketplace · W02 Community contribution · W03 Commons pass · F03 Exit · D09 Conflict of interest
failure_modes: CRM as a centre of power
operational_profiles.escalation: Seek specialist advice on data protection, competition or contract law, or disputed customer retention.
operational_profiles.output: Customer relationship card with origin, access, responsibility, tithe, continuity and exit.

operational_profiles.title: Admission & onboarding
operational_profiles.activate_when: a person or organisation wants to become a guest, member or part of a dynasty
operational_profiles.goal: create open, understandable and fair access with genuine mutual orientation
must_check: Which form of membership or guest status?
Are fundamental rights and minimum duties understood?
Are there specific safety or trust risks?
Are criteria structured rather than based solely on gut feeling?
What barriers or effects on diversity exist?
Is there a review if someone is rejected?
hard_bounds: Not merely a culture-fit test.
No discrimination or admission by clique.
Unpopularity and legitimate dissent are not grounds for rejection.
recommended_path: kleine reale Gemeinsame Tat soweit passend
operational_profiles.culture: Welcoming rituals and local culture are possible; participation remains voluntary.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: F01 Fundamental rights · F02 Non-participation · F03 Exit · B06 Freedom of ritual · B07 Multiple affiliations · K05 Academy
failure_modes: **Culture Fit:** similarity is mistaken for trustworthiness.
**Ritual Test:** cultural participation becomes a hidden duty.
operational_profiles.escalation: For protection or legal risks, minors, legal entities or disputed rejection, involve the relevant legal or review body.
operational_profiles.output: Admission/onboarding dossier with criteria, decision, rights, duties, data protection and review.

operational_profiles.title: Repair ladder
operational_profiles.activate_when: tension, a boundary violation, unreliability or minor harm occurs
operational_profiles.goal: choose the least restrictive safe route to repair and escalate only as needed
must_check: How serious and urgent is the harm?
Is there a power imbalance or a pattern?
What does the affected person need?
When is external or formal help needed?
hard_bounds: No duty to speak directly when there is danger.
No public shaming.
Protection comes before reconciliation.
operational_profiles.culture: Local conversation or reconciliation rituals are possible if voluntary and safe.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: B03 Restorative justice · B04 Rehabilitation · D06 Council · F08 Proportionality · T01 Safety stop
failure_modes: **Endless Conversation:** protection is postponed for the sake of harmony.
**Zero Tolerance:** minor mistakes lead straight to sanctions.
**Forced Mediation:** affected people must “make peace” with the other party.
operational_profiles.escalation: For violence, threats, discrimination, a criminal offence, fundamental rights or a recurring pattern, immediately involve a higher level or specialist body.
operational_profiles.output: Recommended repair level with reasons, protection, people involved, next step and review.

operational_profiles.title: Restorative justice / restitution
operational_profiles.activate_when: harm has been acknowledged and voluntary, safe restitution appears appropriate
operational_profiles.goal: enable responsibility, concrete repair and possible reintegration rather than punishment alone
must_check: What happened and what harm resulted?
What does the affected person need?
Does the person who caused it take responsibility?
hard_bounds: No forced forgiveness.
No substitute for protection, law or necessary sanctions.
No degrading or dangerous rituals.
operational_profiles.culture: Voluntary restitution challenges or rituals may be dignified, proportionate and locally chosen.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: B02 Repair ladder · B04 Rehabilitation · D06 Council · F08 Proportionality · B06 Freedom of ritual
operational_profiles.escalation: For immediate danger, a criminal offence, severe trauma or abuse of power, involve a professional or external body.
operational_profiles.output: Restitution plan with harm, obligations, deadline, protection, review and reintegration.

operational_profiles.title: Rehabilitation & a new reputation
operational_profiles.activate_when: a decision is made about return, trust and reputation after a sanction, conflict or restitution
operational_profiles.goal: enable a real fresh start without denying risks or history
must_check: Which conditions have been fulfilled and harms repaired?
Who needs to know which information?
hard_bounds: No perpetual social punishment.
No automatic return to full trust.
Status or wealth must not make rehabilitation easier.
operational_profiles.culture: A voluntary return or peace ritual can make the social transition visible.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: B02 Repair ladder · B03 Restorative justice · D06 Council · D07 Power map · K05 Angeberschein
operational_profiles.escalation: For ongoing safety or legal risks, involve a protection body; for disputes, the council or an appeal process.
operational_profiles.output: Rehabilitation decision with fulfilled conditions, current boundaries, return plan, data status and review.

operational_profiles.title: Care & Mutual Aid
operational_profiles.activate_when: a person needs emotional, practical or material support, or care is organised on an ongoing basis
operational_profiles.goal: offer voluntary, dignified and sustainable help without a debt of loyalty or invisible ongoing work
must_check: What help does the person actually want?
What boundaries or privacy needs apply?
Are payment, rotation or automation needed instead of thanks?
hard_bounds: Care is an offer, not compulsory emotional service.
Help does not buy friendship, agreement or Mojo.
Sensitive data stays protected.
operational_profiles.culture: Thanks, food or rituals are possible, but never owed.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: W06 Solidarity fund · F02 Non-participation · B10 Institutional warmth · K06 Mentoring · F04 Privacy
failure_modes: “Family” as a claim on private life
operational_profiles.escalation: For health, violence, child welfare, suicide or emergencies, or lasting overload, involve professional services.
operational_profiles.output: Care plan with wishes, consent, scope, helpers, boundaries, data protection and review.

operational_profiles.title: Freedom of ritual & costs-of-saying-no test
operational_profiles.activate_when: a celebration, admission, transition, repair or cultural format is being designed
operational_profiles.goal: enable a strong, diverse culture while ensuring genuine freedom around rituals
must_check: What is its purpose or meaning?
What are the costs of saying no?
Is the ritual dignified, proportionate and accessible?
When may it end or be changed?
hard_bounds: No humiliation, danger or forced intimacy.
No loss of rights or opportunities for not participating.
Local culture must not override fundamental rights.
operational_profiles.culture: Communities and dynasties choose their own names, symbols, celebrations and rituals.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: F02 Non-participation · B01 Admission · B07 Multiple affiliations · B10 Institutional warmth · R10 Constitution day
operational_profiles.escalation: For pressure, sexualised or dangerous practices, minors or conflicts with fundamental rights, carry out a protection or legal review.
operational_profiles.output: Ritual card with purpose, participation, alternative, safety, responsible people and review.

operational_profiles.title: Multiple affiliations
operational_profiles.activate_when: members also belong to other groups, companies, cultures, parties, families or communities
operational_profiles.goal: protect multiple affiliations as a freedom and a source of bridges, while clarifying real conflicts of interest
must_check: Is this merely a difference, or a concrete conflict in a decision?
Which information or interests must be disclosed?
Is recusal or protection of confidential data needed?
Is loyalty being wrongly understood as exclusivity?
hard_bounds: No duty of exclusive affiliation.
Outside contacts are not betrayal.
Concrete conflicts of interest are addressed honestly.
operational_profiles.culture: Multiple cultures, holidays and identities may coexist.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: F02 Non-participation · B08 Hospitality · T07 Network resilience · F05 Equal treatment · R01 Dynasties
failure_modes: Outside contacts are treated as betrayal
operational_profiles.escalation: For conflicts involving confidentiality, competition or mandates, use D09 or a specialist review.
operational_profiles.output: Affiliation/conflict note only when concretely needed, with mitigation and data protection.

operational_profiles.title: Hospitality & open doors
operational_profiles.activate_when: guests, visitors, interested people or partners receive temporary access to spaces, events or projects
operational_profiles.goal: design open doors with clear hospitality, safety, privacy and exit arrangements
must_check: Which spaces or information are accessible?
What protection or accessibility needs exist?
How can a guest find feedback channels or help?
hard_bounds: A guest is neither a member nor free labour.
No surveillance without need.
Private spaces and data stay protected.
operational_profiles.culture: Hospitality may be locally creative; participation in culture remains voluntary.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: B01 Admission · B07 Multiple affiliations · F04 Privacy · F05 Equal treatment · T07 Network resilience
operational_profiles.escalation: For sensitive spaces, minors, safety or data protection, obtain additional approval.
operational_profiles.output: Guest plan with host, access, rules, protection, duration and conclusion.

operational_profiles.title: Rumours, gossip & conflict radius
operational_profiles.activate_when: information about an absent person, a rumour, warning or reputational harm circulates
operational_profiles.goal: direct relevant information to the right audience and a fair process
must_check: Is it private frustration, a safety warning or a formal allegation?
Can the person be spoken with?
Is there danger or a power imbalance?
May this information be relevant to a decision?
hard_bounds: No formal decision based on unverifiable hearsay.
No unnecessary publicity.
Safety warnings may reach safe points of contact.
operational_profiles.culture: A good regulars' gathering talks with people, not about people.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: B02 Repair ladder · B04 Rehabilitation · F04 Privacy · D07 Power map · F05 Equal treatment
operational_profiles.escalation: For immediate danger, violence, vulnerable people or a possible criminal offence, immediately involve a protection or specialist body.
operational_profiles.output: Routing note: category, audience, recipients, uncertainty, next fair step.

operational_profiles.title: Institutional warmth
operational_profiles.activate_when: onboarding, access to help, transitions, spaces or forms of communication are designed around people
operational_profiles.goal: create institutional warmth without forcing friendship, closeness or emotional labour
must_check: Can a person find help and information?
Are quiet or introvert-friendly routes possible?
Are informal circles becoming a shadow parliament?
How can a transition or departure be dignified?
hard_bounds: No prescribed friendship.
No exclusive clique as the gateway to power.
Warmth must not displace privacy or non-participation.
operational_profiles.culture: Food, humour, celebrations and symbols may create warmth; there must always be a quiet alternative.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: F02 Non-participation · B05 Care · B06 Freedom of ritual · B07 Multiple affiliations · B08 Hospitality
operational_profiles.escalation: For exclusion dynamics, bullying or a power clique, use F05/D07/D06.
operational_profiles.output: Warmth and access plan with contact routes, opt-outs, transitions and a power check.

operational_profiles.title: Evidence system
operational_profiles.activate_when: a significant factual claim, scientific rationale or evidence-based recommendation is incorporated into a decision or the book
operational_profiles.goal: make evidence quality, transferability, uncertainty and contrary findings visible
must_check: How transferable is it to FFE?
hard_bounds: No citation theatre.
A study is not a commandment.
Value judgements remain democratic.
operational_profiles.culture: No particular ritual duty; learning from research can be celebrated publicly.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: K02 Decision brief · K03 Fact–forecast–value · K07 Decision journal · K08 Community laboratory · D08 Norm architecture · R05 Mission balance sheet
failure_modes: **Citation Theater:** many sources, no clear claim.
**Evidence Laundering:** a normative preference is sold as science.
operational_profiles.escalation: For high-risk or specialist domains, use external expertise and current primary sources.
operational_profiles.output: Evidence card with claim, source, finding, limitations, transferability, inference and review.

operational_profiles.title: Decision brief
operational_profiles.activate_when: a relevant collective decision is being prepared or affected people need to be informed
operational_profiles.goal: create a shared, understandable information base before the decision
must_check: Who decides and who is affected?
What are the strongest arguments for and against?
hard_bounds: The brief does not make the decision itself.
Do not deliberately hide any option or uncertainty.
Advocacy is labelled as advocacy.
operational_profiles.culture: The design may be inviting; the content remains neutrally accessible.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: K03 Fact–forecast–value · D04 Deliberation · D02 Voting · K01 Evidence system · K07 Decision journal
operational_profiles.escalation: For fundamental rights, safety, law or major specialist uncertainty, add the relevant profiles or specialists.
operational_profiles.output: Three-level decision brief with question, authority, options, arguments, evidence and process.

operational_profiles.title: Fact – forecast – value
operational_profiles.activate_when: debates mix facts, forecasts, values and design assumptions
operational_profiles.goal: separate arguments clearly so that evidence, uncertainty and democratic value judgements are not confused
must_check: Is the statement a fact, forecast, value or design hypothesis?
Who decides the conflict of values?
When can the forecast be checked?
hard_bounds: Values are not disguised as “science says”.
Forecasts are not rewritten after the fact.
Factual errors remain correctable.
operational_profiles.culture: No particular ritual duty; updating an opinion may be acknowledged positively.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: K01 Evidence system · K02 Decision brief · K07 Forecast ledger · D04 Deliberation · R05 Mission balance sheet
failure_modes: Dismissing a fact as merely an opinion
operational_profiles.escalation: For a critical specialist claim, use K01/K04; for a conflict of values or fundamental rights, the relevant democratic level.
operational_profiles.output: Argument card with statement type, evidence, probability, value conflict and review date.

operational_profiles.title: Expertise & teach-back
operational_profiles.activate_when: a decision depends on specialist knowledge, certification or expert judgement
operational_profiles.goal: use expertise without turning it into greater political standing or unchallengeable authority
must_check: Can the explanation be understood through teach-back?
Is there a conflict of interest?
hard_bounds: Expertise carries weight in matters of knowledge, not an extra vote.
No authority outside the domain.
Safety leadership remains narrowly scoped and reviewable.
operational_profiles.culture: Master or teaching titles may celebrate expertise but do not replace a current assessment.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: K01 Evidence system · D04 Deliberation · K05 Angeberschein · K09 Transactive memory · T01 Safety stop
operational_profiles.escalation: For regulated work, high safety stakes or strong dissent, obtain a second or external specialist opinion.
operational_profiles.output: Expertise note with domain, evidence, explanation, boundaries, dissent and recommended action.

operational_profiles.title: Academy, Angeberschein & skill trees
operational_profiles.activate_when: a skill is learned, evidenced, authorised, renewed or used as a prerequisite
operational_profiles.goal: document real, safe competence portably and open up domain-specific development paths
must_check: How current and portable is it?
hard_bounds: No global ranking of people.
A certificate does not replace competence.
Mojo and popularity do not replace evidence of a skill.
External authorisation remains external.
operational_profiles.culture: Dynasties may choose their own titles and ceremonies; their technical meaning stays interoperable.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: K04 Expertise · K06 Mentoring · K09 Transactive memory · W01 Marketplace · W08 Quality · F03 Portability
failure_modes: **Skill Aristocracy:** expertise becomes a political hierarchy.
**No-First-Chance Trap:** no evidence without a job, no job without evidence.
**Mentor Monopoly:** only a few may confirm skills.
operational_profiles.escalation: For regulated trades, safety, minors or assessment disputes, involve a specialist or legal body.
operational_profiles.output: Skill-pass entry with skill, level, evidence, boundaries, confirmation, currency and portability.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ rank/competence and advancement architecture adopted · 🧪 assessment/skill-tree pilot · ⚖️ qualification/safety gate · 🔬 research

operational_profiles.title: Mentoring & multiplying knowledge
operational_profiles.activate_when: knowledge is concentrated in a few people or someone wants supported learning
operational_profiles.goal: transfer knowledge so learners become independent and mentors' power remains limited
must_check: What does the learner want to be able to do?
Is dependency or pressure for loyalty developing?
How does the relationship end or get handed over?
hard_bounds: A mentor does not own the learner.
No allegiance in return.
Do not disguise productive work as learning.
operational_profiles.culture: Completion and progression may be celebrated together.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: K05 Angeberschein · K09 Transactive memory · T04 Bus factor · W05 Working modes · D07 Power map
operational_profiles.escalation: For exploitation, safety, dependency or compensation questions, use W05/D09 or a specialist body.
operational_profiles.output: Mentoring plan with goal, roles, mode, practice, feedback, independence criterion and end.

operational_profiles.title: Decision journal & review
operational_profiles.activate_when: an important decision is made involving assumptions, forecasts or a need for later learning
operational_profiles.goal: make decision quality and learning visible without ranking people
must_check: When and how should it be reviewed?
What would count as disconfirming evidence?
hard_bounds: No ranking people as the “best decision-maker”.
Do not score value judgements with Brier scores.
No retrospective reinterpretation of the original reasons.
operational_profiles.culture: A reasoned change of opinion may be celebrated as learning.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: K01 Evidence system · K02 Decision brief · K08 Community laboratory · R05 Mission balance sheet · T08 Postmortem
operational_profiles.escalation: For serious harm, use T08 or protection procedures; for conflicting evidence, K01.
operational_profiles.output: Decision journal with knowledge at the time, reasons, forecasts, risks and review.

operational_profiles.title: Community-Labor
operational_profiles.activate_when: a new method, institution, app feature or way of working has not yet been sufficiently tried
operational_profiles.goal: learn in a controlled way without treating fundamental rights or protection as experimental material
must_check: When is it stopped or scaled?
hard_bounds: An experiment is not an exception to fundamental rights.
No secret experiments.
Do not pilot essential services without safeguards.
operational_profiles.culture: Experiments may be playful; participation and experimental status stay visible.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: K01 Evidence system · K07 Decision journal · R08 Institutional lifecycle · F01 Fundamental rights · F04 Privacy
operational_profiles.escalation: For significant risk, legal issues, vulnerable groups or sensitive data, carry out a specialist, ethics or legal review.
operational_profiles.output: Experiment protocol with hypothesis, scope, protection, measurement, duration, stop and review.

operational_profiles.title: Transactive memory / “Who knows what?”
operational_profiles.activate_when: it is unclear who holds which knowledge, or critical knowledge depends on a few people
operational_profiles.goal: build a reliable shared answer to “Who knows what, and where is it?”
must_check: Who can apply or explain it?
How current and accessible is it?
Which data must not be widely visible?
hard_bounds: No surveillance graph of competence or friendship.
Knowledge holders retain data protection and boundaries.
No individual as a permanent bottleneck.
operational_profiles.culture: Knowledge markets and learning festivals may make expertise visible.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: K05 Angeberschein · K06 Mentoring · K10 Rubin AI · T04 Bus factor · D07 Power map
failure_modes: AI becomes the only search interface
operational_profiles.escalation: For critical safety, confidential or root knowledge, use T05/T06 and the responsible specialist role.
operational_profiles.output: Knowledge map with topic, sources, contacts, access, backup, currency and gaps.

operational_profiles.title: Rubin AI as a navigator
operational_profiles.activate_when: Rubin-KI or another AI explains a rule, routes cases or produces specific instructions for action
operational_profiles.goal: apply current FFE norms and methods understandably without simulating power, truth or human worth
must_check: What is the situation, and which facts are missing?
Which core pages or profiles are activated?
What is a rule, recommendation or experiment?
Which data does the AI really need?
When must a human or specialist body decide?
hard_bounds: AI is a navigator, not a government.
No invented norm or hidden score.
Manueller/humaner Fallback bleibt.
Archives are not routed as current rules.
operational_profiles.culture: AI may use cultural language but must keep function and voluntariness understandable.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: F04 Privacy · F09 Access to rules · D08 Norm architecture · W01 Marketplace · K01 Evidence · T05 Access power · T06 Cybersecurity · T10 Fallback
failure_modes: **Automation Bias:** people trust AI too quickly.
**Social Scoring:** helpful data becomes an overall ranking of people.
**Data Creep:** ever more data because it is “useful”.
operational_profiles.escalation: For law, safety, medicine, serious conflict, fundamental rights or high uncertainty, involve a human specialist or decision-making body.
operational_profiles.output: FFE guidance with activated IDs, questions, boundaries, steps, tools, escalation, status and sources.

operational_profiles.title: Stop-the-line / safety stop
operational_profiles.activate_when: a plausible, specific danger to people, property, the environment or critical systems is identified
operational_profiles.goal: stop dangerous activity within a narrow scope and safely authorise its resumption
must_check: How urgent is it, and how broad is the scope?
What must be made safe immediately?
Which expertise determines authorisation to resume?
How should it be documented and reviewed?
hard_bounds: A justified safety stop must not be punished for being inconvenient.
Safety is not a blanket political veto.
Stop only as much and as long as necessary.
operational_profiles.culture: Clear shared stop signals can be practised culturally.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: F08 Proportionality · B02 Repair ladder · T02 Incident mode · T08 Postmortem · K04 Expertise · W05 Working modes
failure_modes: **Rights on Paper:** officially anyone may stop work, but in practice they are punished.
**Safety Veto:** a safety argument becomes a weapon for political obstruction.
**Cry Wolf:** repeated unfounded stops destroy trust.
**Rank Override:** the boss ignores operational expertise.
operational_profiles.escalation: For immediate danger to life or health, emergency services, authorities or specialists come before community processes.
operational_profiles.output: Safety-stop record with danger, scope, safeguards, expertise, resumption criteria and restart.

operational_profiles.title: Incident-Modus
operational_profiles.activate_when: an accident, near miss, attack, data breach, outage or serious operational disruption occurs
operational_profiles.goal: limit harm, coordinate responsibilities and then learn at a systemic level
must_check: How serious and time-critical is it?
Who or what must be protected?
Which evidence or data must be secured?
When should normal operations or the postmortem begin?
hard_bounds: Stabilise before assigning blame.
No cover-up.
Privacy and fair treatment apply during an incident too.
operational_profiles.culture: Calm shared rituals or signals can reduce panic; facts remain clear.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: T01 Safety stop · T08 Postmortem · F08 Proportionality · T10 Fallback · D01 Subsidiarity
operational_profiles.escalation: For an emergency, criminal offence, reporting duty, health or cyber incident, involve external bodies immediately.
operational_profiles.output: Incident log with severity, timeline, protection, roles, communication, recovery and follow-up.

operational_profiles.title: Checklists, closed loop & handoffs
operational_profiles.activate_when: critical recurring steps, handovers or messages are prone to error
operational_profiles.goal: reduce memory and communication errors with lean checklists and confirmed handoffs
must_check: What does not belong on the checklist?
hard_bounds: No checklist bureaucracy for trivial work.
No hidden micromonitoring.
Ticking boxes does not replace responsibility.
operational_profiles.culture: Teams may use their own terms or signals as long as misunderstandings are ruled out.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: T01 Safety stop · T02 Incident mode · W09 Integrator · W08 Quality · T08 Postmortem
failure_modes: Ticking boxes without an actual check
operational_profiles.escalation: For safety or legal processes, use the professional standard; for overload, R06 Bureaucracy Radar.
operational_profiles.output: Process card with trigger, checklist, confirmation, handover, responsible person and version.

operational_profiles.title: Bus factor & continuity
operational_profiles.activate_when: a function, access or knowledge depends on individual people
operational_profiles.goal: ensure continuity without constant availability or a cult of heroes
must_check: What stops working if they or it are unavailable?
Which documentation or access is missing?
What safety boundaries apply to redundancy?
hard_bounds: Nobody owes constant availability.
Redundancy must not duplicate secrets without control.
Being irreplaceable is not an ideal status.
operational_profiles.culture: Handover and enabling others may merit Mojo and celebration.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: R07 Succession · T10 Fallback · W04 Infrastructure · K09 Transactive memory · D07 Power map
operational_profiles.escalation: For root, financial or safety access, use T05/T06/D09; for founder dependency, R07.
operational_profiles.output: Continuity plan with function, consequences of failure, backup, documentation, access and test date.

operational_profiles.title: Digital constitution & access power
operational_profiles.activate_when: digital platforms, admin rights, keys, deployments or algorithmic rules are being designed
operational_profiles.goal: limit technical access power like constitutional power and make it accountable
must_check: Who owns or manages systems and keys?
Who can change rules or data alone?
How do emergency access, succession and exit work?
hard_bounds: No root dictator.
Least privilege and no secret rule changes.
Admin rights are power and require oversight.
operational_profiles.culture: Technical titles or symbols may recognise competence; they do not create political authority.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: K10 Rubin AI · F04 Privacy · D07 Power map · T06 Security · T10 Fallback
failure_modes: Audit Log controlled by same actor
operational_profiles.escalation: For critical infrastructure, payment data, personal data or external hosting, carry out a security or legal review.
operational_profiles.output: Digital constitution with ownership, roles, rights, logs, changes, emergency access, succession and exit.

operational_profiles.title: Cybersecurity & Privacy Engineering
operational_profiles.activate_when: a system, device, network or data process is built, changed or operated
operational_profiles.goal: build in security and data protection from the start and make failures or attacks manageable
hard_bounds: Security does not justify total surveillance.
Data minimisation is a protective measure.
No insecure default access.
operational_profiles.culture: Security culture may be practised playfully but must not create a culture of blame or fear.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: F04 Privacy · T05 Access power · T02 Incident mode · T10 Fallback · K10 Rubin AI
operational_profiles.escalation: For personal or critical data, payment or health systems, or an attack, involve specialists and observe duties towards authorities.
operational_profiles.output: Security/privacy plan with assets, threats, controls, tests, recovery and responsible people.

operational_profiles.title: Network resilience
operational_profiles.activate_when: suppliers, income, knowledge, infrastructure or connections are too concentrated
operational_profiles.goal: create diversity, bridges, alternatives and controlled redundancy to handle disruptions
must_check: What is the single point of failure?
hard_bounds: Diversity without interfaces is fragmentation.
Redundancy must not be unjustified waste.
No monoculture for convenience.
operational_profiles.culture: Dynasties may develop different strategies; interoperability remains shared.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: D07 Power map · B07 Multiple affiliations · K09 Transactive memory · T04 Bus factor · R01 Dynasties
operational_profiles.escalation: For critical supplies, financial, cyber or safety risks, involve a higher level or specialist planning.
operational_profiles.output: Resilience plan with nodes, dependencies, alternatives, costs, drills and review.

operational_profiles.title: Error report & postmortem
operational_profiles.activate_when: an error, outage, near miss or unexpected result creates a need to learn
operational_profiles.goal: learn from events without hiding those responsible or shaming people
hard_bounds: A postmortem does not replace personal responsibility.
No blame culture or cover-up.
Protect sensitive data.
operational_profiles.culture: A work harvest or learning ritual can recognise honest failure.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: T01 Safety stop · K07 Decision journal · B02 Repair ladder · B04 Rehabilitation · R09 Organisation check
operational_profiles.escalation: For a criminal offence, safety, data breach reporting duties or serious harm, involve an external body in parallel.
operational_profiles.output: Postmortem with timeline, factors, impact, measures, owners, deadlines and follow-up.

operational_profiles.title: Operations & logistics
operational_profiles.activate_when: recurring work, capacity, materials, dates or several parallel projects are being coordinated
operational_profiles.goal: organise visible workflow, realistic capacity and reliable handovers
hard_bounds: No hidden ranking of individuals' productivity.
No unrealistic utilisation as the norm.
System metrics before surveillance.
operational_profiles.culture: Team rituals such as short stand-ups are optional and should be assessed for usefulness.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: W01 Marketplace · W09 Integrator · T03 Handoffs · W04 Infrastructure · R06 Bureaucracy radar
operational_profiles.escalation: For safety, working-time or employment law, critical logistics or overload, involve the responsible body.
operational_profiles.output: Operations plan with flow, capacity, WIP, roles, stocks, dates, risks and review.

operational_profiles.title: Graceful degradation & manual fallback
operational_profiles.activate_when: technology, staffing or infrastructure partly fails and minimum operations must be maintained
operational_profiles.goal: continue in a controlled, limited mode and return safely to normal operations
must_check: How are recovery and reconciliation handled?
hard_bounds: Rights and help must not be accessible only digitally.
A manual fallback must not be unsafe.
Degraded operation must not secretly become the permanent standard.
operational_profiles.culture: Clear symbols for operating modes can provide orientation.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: K10 Rubin AI · T04 Bus factor · T05 Access power · T02 Incident mode · F09 Access to rules
operational_profiles.escalation: At a safety or legal boundary, stop the service rather than degrade it unsafely.
operational_profiles.output: Fallback runbook with levels, essential functions, manual routes, roles, recovery and reconciliation.

operational_profiles.title: Dynasties & polycentric circles
operational_profiles.activate_when: a group works together long-term or grows around a place, field, project, culture, product or commons
operational_profiles.goal: build autonomous dynasties with their own cultures, skill and office pathways, and clear shared boundaries
must_check: What is the purpose and scope?
Which offices or councils are actually needed?
Which interfaces to FFE and other dynasties?
hard_bounds: A dynasty is not a feudal fiefdom.
Fundamental rights and portable membership rights remain.
Add structure only in response to a real trigger.
operational_profiles.culture: Names, ranks, rituals and celebrations are chosen locally; technical meanings stay compatible.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: D01 Subsidiarity · W03 Commons pass · B07 Multiple affiliations · T07 Network resilience · R02 Federation
operational_profiles.escalation: For legal entity status, employment, large funds, safety or federal conflicts, involve a higher level or specialist review.
operational_profiles.output: Dynasty charter with purpose, rights, portfolio, councils/offices, commons, interfaces, exit and review.
operational_profiles.norm_status: ✅ dynasty/office/development architecture adopted · 🧪 organisation pilot · ⚖️ legal gate

operational_profiles.title: Federation / Die Illuminati
operational_profiles.activate_when: several dynasties or communities have a genuinely shared task, infrastructure, norm or external relationship
operational_profiles.goal: create a federal level with enumerated powers without swallowing local autonomy
must_check: Which task cannot be fully resolved locally?
How are costs, information and appeals governed?
How do powers return to the local level, or exit take place?
Which fundamental rights or interfaces apply jointly?
hard_bounds: Die Illuminati is not a secret supreme authority.
Powers are enumerated, not unlimited.
Local agency and fundamental rights remain.
operational_profiles.culture: The cultural name Die Illuminati is self-ironic; genuine transparency remains mandatory.
operational_profiles.cross_checks: R01 Dynasties · D01 Subsidiarity · W03 Commons · W07 Capital · T07 Network resilience · R03 Friendly separation
failure_modes: A solidarity fund permanently rescues bad structures
Federal administration becomes an end in itself
